battle_phases.completion_condition: Hibiscus is deployed, the opening lower thrower is dead, and all hostile routes remain closed.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A blocker death or missing Fang grant invalidates the opening and downstream deployments; later surplus DP cannot erase the leak.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four interceptions without repeating Vanilla's shell-assisted death.
handoff_requirements: Hibiscus takes over central healing before Lancet's later withdrawal.
responsibilities: Fang and Midnight clear the upper central thrower, then contribute to Friston's enemy.
Friston holds the lower central thrower outside the opening artillery acquisition radius.
Melantha intercepts the lower outer thrower; Midnight intercepts the upper outer thrower.
Lancet supplies the deployment heal and lower-side healing.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with 10 DP and all four restraints active.
survival_dependencies: Friston must survive until crossfire removes his first enemy.
Fang must survive to produce the opening automatic DP grants.
No unsupported Friston talent is included in the survival budget.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both eastern restraints are destroyed, Beagle and central Melantha are deployed, and artillery #0 is dead by frame 4500.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A surviving artillery unit threatens the waiting civilians and later high-ground formation. An artillery miss or medical death is a combat failure, not an economic correction.
battle_phases.goal: Sustain the eastern artillery engagement while completing eastern civilian release and installing permanent lower outer defense.
handoff_requirements: Melantha leaves only after her opening hostile pair and eastern restraint are cleared; the next lower outer spawn is at 116 seconds.
Beagle is deployed at 94.03 seconds, well before that next contact.
Steward's withdrawal does not cancel already-created projectiles.
responsibilities: Ansel and Hibiscus maintain central and medical survival.
Hibiscus directly heals Steward during the artillery window.
Midnight clears restraint #3; opening Melantha clears #4 before withdrawing.
Beagle occupies the lower outer route during its spawn gap.
Returning Melantha adds lower central damage before armored contact.
battle_phases.start_condition: Opening interceptions are established and Hibiscus is deployed.
survival_dependencies: Steward must remain alive for the required actual artillery hits.
Ansel must heal Hibiscus while Hibiscus spends packets on Steward.
Civilian transit past eastern officers must incur no protected-target death.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Central hostiles, including #34, are dead by frame 7800; no hostile is held by Melantha.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An older armored survivor can consume capacity needed by later throwers or #34. A released hostile invalidates zero-leak acceptance even if civilian clearance later succeeds.
battle_phases.goal: Clear both armored pairs, throwers and officer queues without exhausting central block capacity.
handoff_requirements: Friston remains deployed when Melantha leaves.
Upper restraint clearance transfers to actual civilian transit, not an assumed arrival.
No remaining blocked enemy is released by the frame-7800 withdrawal.
responsibilities: Lava supplies single-target arts to both central blockers.
Melantha damages Friston's held armor and throwers; Ansel sustains her.
Midnight handles upper outer officers and assists centrally during acquisition gaps.
Beagle holds and gradually clears the lower outer queues.
Returning Steward destroys western upper restraint #1.
battle_phases.start_condition: Artillery clearance is established and the persistent blockers remain alive.
survival_dependencies: Both medics continue covering Friston and Fang.
Beagle's fresh HP and base defense must last through his complete queue; no external healing is assumed.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both civilians have safely arrived, all spawns are exhausted, no active enemies remain, remaining life is positive and leaks remain zero.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A trapped or dead civilian prevents project acceptance even after all hostile enemies are cleared.
battle_phases.goal: Release the remaining western civilian and establish the complete terminal predicate.
handoff_requirements: Destroying a restraint must produce actual release and subsequent safe-arrival events.
Do not terminate on kill count, last spawn time or positive life alone.
responsibilities: Permanent blockers and medicine remain deployed through residual officer cleanup.
Melantha returns at [6,3] LEFT to destroy western restraint #2.
Steward completes upper restraint clearance if still needed.
Count protected arrivals and deaths independently of enemy kills.
battle_phases.start_condition: Central combat is cleared and Melantha has begun her redeployment cooldown.
survival_dependencies: Waiting civilians remain outside the officers' 1.2 attack radius at the planned blocking positions.
No ordinary-operator civilian blocking or healing is credited.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward damages artillery from the eastern station; Hibiscus sustains him. The artillery must die before the eastern withdrawal and before any western civilian exposure.
Midnight clears eastern restraint #3. Returning Steward clears western restraint #1. Record the upper civilian's actual safe arrival.
Opening Melantha clears eastern restraint #4. Beagle intercepts later officers upstream of western restraint #2. Final Melantha deployment clears #2; record the lower civilian's actual safe arrival.
Fang blocks upper central traffic. Midnight contributes when not self-blocked; Lava supplies arts. Clear the older armor before later throwers exhaust Fang's two-block capacity.

Friston blocks lower central traffic. Fang contributes during upper gaps; central Melantha supplies sustained adjacent damage. Lava and both medics support the armored and thrower overlap, including final armor #34.
Midnight intercepts upper outer traffic throughout. His self-blocked targets can interrupt central assistance. Ansel's extended-range windows replenish his HP.
Melantha handles the opening pair; fresh Beagle handles every later lower outer officer without a timed combat replacement.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper central block; assist Friston when not self-blocked; automatic income.
Upper outer interception, eastern upper restraint clearance, and central crossfire.
Opening lower outer interception and eastern lower restraint clearance.
Opening global heal and ordinary healing of Friston and Melantha.
Direct eastern Steward healing, central healing, and Ansel support.
Central healing, Hibiscus support, Melantha support, and periodic extended healing of Midnight.
Permanent interception of the later lower outer officers.
Attack enemies held by Friston; provide downstream emergency interception.
Shared central single-target arts after the artillery window.
Western upper restraint clearance after redeployment.
Western lower restraint clearance after central combat.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward remains at the observed [5,7] DOWN firing position. He is two tiles from Ansel and more than three from Hibiscus. Lava enters after the planned artillery clearance, avoiding an additional vulnerable target beside Hibiscus during that engagement.
formation_structure.capacity: Exactly ten distinct IDs. At most eight rarity-2/3 operators coexist, plus Friston-3. The inspected current runtime exempts rarity-1 operators from its deployment counter.
formation_structure.central: Friston supplies three-block capacity. Melantha attacks his held enemies from adjacent [4,4], while Ansel heals her. Lava covers both central blocker tiles. No Friston damage-resistance talent, Lava splash, random talent, or commanded target priority is credited.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural +1 DP/s, Fang cost 10.
economy.conservative_balances: Ignoring all refunds: Midnight@571 leaves approximately 6.03 DP; Melantha@841 and Lancet@931 each leave 0.03; Hibiscus@1321 leaves 2.03; Ansel@1771 leaves 0.03; Steward@2131 leaves 0.03. Beagle@2821 is affordable before his next contact.
economy.critical_skill_income: Fang's living automatic activations at frames 570, 1320 and 2070 fund the opening through Steward.
economy.refund_policy: No retreat refund is required by the declared deployment budget.
economy.survival_dependency: Fang must remain alive through frame 2070. Crossfire and the two established medics support that dependency; missing income is not repaired by assuming another operator's skill.

formation_structure.medicine: Hibiscus covers Fang, Friston, Ansel, Steward and Lava. Ansel covers Hibiscus, Fang, Friston, central Melantha and Lava. Only Hibiscus directly heals eastern Steward. Ansel's active forward extension reaches Midnight; ordinary Ansel range does not.
formation_structure.opening: Fang faces UP so that, after clearing his own blocked enemy, he can attack Friston's tile. Midnight covers both central blocker tiles. Friston's [4,5] position is three columns from the artillery's opening western flight line, outside its source rangeRadius 2.0; this removes the demonstrated opening shell on [4,4].
formation_structure.outer: Midnight remains upper outer throughout. Melantha completes the opening lower outer assignment before withdrawing; Beagle enters long before the next lower outer officer. Beagle's later survival uses base defense and HP, without assumed healing or defensive-talent credit.

formation_transitions.transition: Complete all four opening interceptions and add Lancet's deployment heal before the next lower central attack cycle.
Complete overlapping central medicine and reciprocal medical coverage.
Withdraw Lancet before sustained eastern artillery exposure; no blocker is released.
Withdraw opening Melantha after the lower thrower, first lower outer officer and eastern lower restraint are cleared.
Install Steward before the saved engagement's first observed damage time.
Install fresh Beagle during the lower outer spawn gap.
Return Melantha behind Friston before the first armored pair.
End Steward's eastern assignment after the declared artillery kill window; existing projectiles remain independently relevant.
Install shared central arts after artillery clearance.
Return Steward to clear the western upper restraint while the central formation remains deployed.
Release Melantha after central clearance; retain Friston, Fang, Midnight, Beagle, Lava and both medics.
Return Melantha to clear the western lower restraint and finish protected-target evacuation.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Use only the ten listed normal-mode rarity-1/2/3 IDs. Every deployment uses the declared integer [row,col] tile and direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Friston must remain alive and retain the first lower thrower until its death. A BLOCK event alone does not establish success; require no released hostile and no leak through frame 990.
Credit Fang income only while he remains deployed and alive. Do not credit Vanilla income, hypothetical refunds, robot DP talents or death refunds.

Eastern lower restraint #4 must be destroyed before Melantha's frame-2010 withdrawal. Midnight must destroy eastern upper restraint #3 before later upper officers can repeatedly reach the waiting civilian.

Artillery #0 must be dead by frame 4500. Continue checking projectile impacts separately. Failure of this deadline invalidates the later formation; the fixed action list contains no executable conditional repair.
Only Hibiscus is credited with direct eastern Steward healing. Central Melantha depends on Ansel. Midnight depends on Ansel's active range extension after Lancet leaves.

Friston's three slots and Fang's two slots must never overflow into a leak. Melantha supplies lower damage and downstream reserve interception; she is not a substitute for killing older armor before later arrivals.

Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Western waiting positions remain more than 1.2 tiles from the planned outer officer blocking positions. Do not infer safety merely from positive objective life.
Melantha must hold no hostile at frame 7800. Her withdrawal follows the central clearance deadline while all permanent blockers remain deployed.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths, and two observed safe protected-target arrivals. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Keep Friston alive through the first lower thrower using Fang/Midnight crossfire and Lancet. Close both outer routes before contact.
Complete medicine, clear eastern restraints, establish Beagle, sustain Steward, and kill artillery. Return Melantha before armored contact.
Clear both armored pairs and all throwers with Friston/Melantha/Lava cooperation; sustain Midnight's officer queues; clear the western upper restraint.
Maintain remaining interception, clear the western lower restraint, observe both safe arrivals, and wait for the complete terminal predicate.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP only; no manual activation actions.
First arts window completes eastern upper restraint clearance; second strengthens the first armored overlap and final upper outer officers.
Support eastern Steward during artillery exposure, then strengthen healing during the final central overlap.
Strengthen central/medical healing and extend coverage to Midnight during the listed windows.
Boost damage against lower central armor and subsequent throwers after redeployment SP has recovered.
Accelerate single-target arts during the first armored overlap and final armored clearance.
Ordinary arts and automatic attack-SP strikes; do not command or assume a general highest-defense targeting rule.
Ordinary three-block defense and physical damage; no healing or skill dependency.
Ordinary three-block containment; no unsupported deployment damage resistance.
Supported 200-point deployment heal and ordinary opening healing; no civilian-healing credit.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Replace Vanilla's unsupported survival dependency with Friston-3 at [4,5], opening crossfire from Fang and Midnight, and early Lancet support. Establish medicine before sustained artillery exposure. Preserve Steward's observed eastern firing position, add Melantha behind the lower central blocker, and retain Beagle on the lower outer corridor. Clear the western restraints after combat has stabilized. This is an unexecuted full-stage hypothesis.

revised_stage_understanding.artillery_damage_basis: Using catalog ATK 470 against RES 50, ordinary hits deal 235 and automatic scaled hits deal 446.5. Forty-eight hits with nine scaled hits total 13183.5 damage. Continued acquisition and survival are required; the saved prefix does not prove the complete window.
revised_stage_understanding.coordinates: All plan tiles are [row,col]. The forbidden device tiles are exactly [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
revised_stage_understanding.fact_model_unknown_separation: Stats, source moveMultiplier 0.5 and range geometry are source-backed. Spawn frames, attack scheduling, deployment counting and combat selection are current-model rules. Exact client timing, general target tie-breaks and ordinary roadblock navigation remain UNKNOWN.
revised_stage_understanding.protected_targets: Both civilians are neutral. Safe arrival costs no life; death costs one life. Western restraints intentionally retain them until dedicated clearance, while upstream interception separates them from officers.
revised_stage_understanding.retained_observation: The saved V1 events show Steward landing 15 consecutive artillery hits from 72.03 through 94.43 seconds at [5,7] DOWN before his death. This supports retaining that engagement position, not assuming unrestricted future target priority.
revised_stage_understanding.verified_cause: Vanilla's first block was real, but a preceding 760-damage artillery hit and subsequent melee attacks killed her before the later income dependency. The revision changes opening geometry, crossfire and healing rather than repairing ledger arithmetic.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: An opening lower blocker outside the western artillery radius can survive with Fang/Midnight crossfire and Lancet support. Early overlapping medicine can extend the observed eastern Steward engagement, while three-block lower containment, adjacent Melantha damage and delayed shared arts can absorb the complete mixed-wave schedule within ten IDs.
principal_falsifiers: Friston dies before the first lower thrower.
Steward's observed engagement does not continue sufficiently to kill artillery.
Medical allocation fails during artillery exposure.
A central queue overflows or a protected target dies.

required_full_stage_observations: Both eastern restraints destroyed before their clearance assignments end.
Artillery dead by frame 4500, with pending impacts resolved separately.
Older armor cleared before central capacity is exhausted.
Two protected-target safe arrivals and zero protected-target deaths.
Zero leaks and the complete positive-life win predicate.
required_opening_observations: Fang produces the credited grants while alive.
unsupported_effects_excluded: civilian blocking or attacking by ordinary operators
revised_tactical_requirements.verification_scope: Range checks and time-SP spacing were checked read-only. They establish neither healing packet allocation nor battle feasibility.

changed_responsibilities: Friston replaces Vanilla as the permanent lower central blocker; no Vanilla income is used.
Fang faces UP to assist lower containment after clearing his own enemy.
Lancet supports the opening instead of arriving after the failure.
Hibiscus directly sustains eastern Steward, while Ansel supports Hibiscus and central units.
Beagle takes the later lower outer queues without a combat replacement.
Melantha returns behind Friston before armor, then performs final lower western clearance.
Steward performs upper western clearance after his eastern assignment and redeployment cooldown.
revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the opening interception hypothesis and inspect the actual contact path and deployment state. Even if BLOCK occurs, require Friston to survive until the thrower's death and preserve zero leaks; do not treat the first observable event as proof of the later survival or economic chain.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Moving lower opening containment to [4,5], adding Fang's forward crossfire and replacing the fragile vanguard with Friston removes the demonstrated shell-assisted survival failure. Dedicated medicine then supports the observed artillery engagement, while Melantha supplies lower central clearance behind a persistent three-block holder.
